content.bridge_context: Exploring balance and proportion in shapes, where one half is a mirror image of the other.

units.title: What is Symmetry?
units.explanation: If a figure can be folded into two identical halves, it is symmetric.
units.dual_language_instruction: Look at a butterfly. If you fold it down the middle, do the wings match? / एक तितली को देखें। यदि आप उसे बीच से मोड़ते हैं, तो क्या पंख मिलते हैं?

units.title: Line of Symmetry
units.explanation: The imaginary line where you fold the figure is the line of symmetry.
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw a heart shape and find its line of symmetry. / एक हृदय का आकार बनाएं और उसकी सममिति रेखा खोजें।
